title: What a Good Faith & Price Estimates Version Lists
content:
**Rule.** Each Good Faith & Price Estimates version lists, per provider or facility, every expected item or service with its service code and expected charge, together with the expected diagnosis codes where the estimate type requires them and the standard disclaimer of the type.

**Riverbend's own expected charges** follow the type's expected-charge basis:
- on self-pay good faith estimates, gross charges less the uninsured discount of the account type the service will be billed under;
- on package types, the package price for the service code from the package price schedule (including Riverbend Medical Group professional fees where the type includes them);
- on insured estimates, the contracted rate applied to the patient's remaining deductible, coinsurance and copay.

**Co-providers.** Where the type carries co-provider lines, the expected charges of each co-provider role of the type are requested from the co-provider, who has the type's co-provider submission period in business days to send them, and are listed under the co-provider's own name.

**Lines and total.** A version carries at most the type's maximum number of lines; a line is recorded once per version, provider role and service code — whether a line already stands is read from the lines already recorded on the estimate. The estimate total is the sum of all lines of the current version, provider by provider.

## When a line counts as already recorded

| New line compared with an existing line | Recorded again? |
|---|---|
| same version, same provider role, same service code | no — the line stands once |
| same version and code, different provider role (e.g. Riverbend facility and Riverbend professional) | yes — a separate line |
| same provider role and code, a later version | yes — a line of the new version |

## Example (hypothetical figures)

A current version lists a Riverbend facility line of 2000.00, a Riverbend professional line of 600.00 and an anesthesia co-provider line of 400.00. The estimate total is 3000.00: the sum of every line of that version, the co-provider line included.
